external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app to borrow, renew, or reserve books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manually change loan and member account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone that submits borrowing, renewal, and reservation requests to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that applies loan rules and is the only stated interface that reads or writes loan records.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Exposure claims disagree: Lending service note says "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript says "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet."

processes.name: kiosk
processes.description: A self-service branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books and which sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, names, email addresses, home addresses, borrowing history, loans, and reservations.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.

data_flows.name: borrow books
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew, or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member details, renewal requests, and reservation requests

data_flows.name: write loan changes
data_flows.description: The library app submits borrowing, renewal, and reservation requests to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.data_description: The selected book or title, member information, and loan or reservation change

data_flows.name: send loan returns
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: Scanned member card, books, loans, and returns

data_flows.name: change loan records
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.
data_flows.data_description: Loan changes, account-block changes, and manual return records

data_flows.name: read write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Member records, loans, reservations, and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks operate and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network over which phones directly reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.assumption: The lending API presents a web interface because it is explicitly described as a REST API.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out." REST is a web interface kind under the extraction rules.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states that the database contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and every member's full borrowing history; disclosure of this personal data is confidential.
